* Set brand navy from the technician uniform photos

Samples the actual navy uniform color across 6 real photos (avg
#2f3b53) and uses it as the --primary design token, replacing the
earlier hand-picked navy so the brand color is grounded in the real
photography instead of an arbitrary choice.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01HamkRNAsWV1c3cf4Nz1C5q

* Add a "Recent Work" project gallery to each service page

Each service page now has 4 numbered photo slots
(serviceImages.<slug>.gallery) rendered as a "Recent Work" grid.
Empty slots show an honest "Photo N — Coming soon" placeholder
instead of repeating the same icon art four times, so the page never
looks broken or padded while photos are still being collected.
